lyrics:
[Intro: three-note synth whistle riff, heavy claps, hype man shouts]
Okay! Okay!
Let's go

[Verse 1: smooth male tenor, sung low and quick]
I was heading for the exit with my jacket on my arm
Said I'd be in bed by ten, I set a real alarm
Then the lights went low and the bass came through the floor
And my boy said "one more song," and I said

[Chorus: shouted hook, the crowd answers]
Okay! (Okay!)
She said "you dancing?" I said okay! (Okay!)
One more hour? Okay! (Okay!)
I'll regret it in the morning and that's okay
Okay, okay, okay

[Verse 2: smooth male tenor, more playful]
Now I've got a meeting and a dentist and a plan
I've been so responsible I don't know who I am
But the DJ's got a record that I haven't heard in years
And my feet have made a motion and my common sense agrees

[Chorus: shouted hook, the crowd answers]
Okay! (Okay!)
She said "you dancing?" I said okay! (Okay!)
One more hour? Okay! (Okay!)
I'll regret it in the morning and that's okay
Okay, okay, okay

[Rap Verse: fast male guest, comic, beat strips to bass and claps]
I got a babysitter billing by the minute and I'm in it
Told her back by half past ten and now I'm pushing every limit
Got a text that says "where are you," got a tab I didn't open
Got a knee that isn't working and a hip that's barely coping
But I'm sliding to the left like it's two thousand and four
Somebody call my chiropractor, tell him clear the floor
If you came here with your coat on, go ahead and check it
If you said you're leaving early, then you already wrecked it

[Bridge: half-time, sung softly, pad and finger snaps]
Been saying no so long
I forgot the other word
Somebody asked me nicely
And this is what they heard

[Final Chorus: everyone, synth riff louder, whistles]
Okay! (Okay!)
She said "you dancing?" I said okay! (Okay!)
One more hour? Okay! (Okay!)
I'll regret it in the morning and that's okay
Okay, okay, okay

[Outro: synth riff alone, an alarm going off, laughter]
Okay
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 105 BPM, 4/4, G minor. A hard, bouncing club groove with a lot of low end. Loud and funny.

VOICE: Three men. A smooth R&B tenor who sings the verses lightly and quickly, with little runs at the ends of lines. A hype man with a hoarse shout who yells the hook word and the ad-libs. A guest rapper with a fast, bouncing, comic delivery and exaggerated consonants. A crowd repeats the hook.

INSTRUMENTS: A high, piercing synth playing a three-note figure that repeats for the whole song. Heavy 808 kick and bass. Loud layered handclaps. A whistle-like second synth. Sparse string stabs. A soft pad and finger snaps in the bridge. An alarm tone at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, the synth figure, claps and shouts. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:36 Chorus 1. 0:55 Verse 2. 1:17 Chorus 2. 1:36 Rap verse, eight lines over bass and claps. 2:00 Bridge, half time and sung softly. 2:18 Final chorus, twice through. 2:56 The synth figure rides with ad-libs. 3:30 Outro, the synth alone, an alarm clock, laughter, one word at 3:45.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2000s Atlanta crunk-and-R&B: enormous sub-bass, bright piercing synth, claps wide, vocals dry and upfront.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The synth figure with the first shout in the opening two seconds.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The temptation is to stay out past ten. The narrator has a dentist appointment and a babysitter, and the bridge says what is really going on: he had forgotten how to say yes.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Resistance, surrender, comedy, a moment of truth, celebration.
